decisions.boundary_condition: Do not treat balcony as mandatory unless the current request explicitly says it is required. Do not infer an ocean view or any specific view from the balcony preference alone.
decisions.canonical_value: Prefer a hotel room with a balcony, especially when the room is above the first floor or the floor is unknown; a first-floor room can waive the balcony preference.
decisions.condition: Use when searching for, booking, or evaluating hotel room amenities, particularly when the room is above the first floor or the floor has not been specified.
decisions.default_action: Ask for or verify that the hotel room has a balcony as a soft default preference.
decisions.exception_condition: If the room is on the first floor, the balcony preference may be waived.
decisions.name: hotel_room_balcony_preference
decisions.preference_value: Prefers a hotel room with a balcony when booking or evaluating rooms.
decisions.rationale: Supported by multiple hotel-room amenity requests mentioning a balcony, with one explicit flexibility condition that a first-floor room does not need one. The evidence supports a soft balcony preference rather than an always-mandatory requirement, and does not justify adding an ocean-view requirement.
